select amrl.*, ( select scvb.meaning from sys_code_b svb,sys_code_value_b scvb where svb.code_id = scvb.code_id and svb.code = 'FND.MEETING_RISK_TYPE' and scvb.value = amrl.meeting_risk_category ) as meeting_risk_category_desc,
(case when amrl.risk_status = 'DELETED' then '已删除' else '未删除' end)status_desc, amrl.last_update_date last_updated_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=amrl.last_updated_by)last_updated_person
from act_meeting_risk_list amrl where 1 = 1
and process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}
order by creation_date

SELECT amrl.* FROM ACT_MEETING_RISK_LIST amrl WHERE amrl.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID IN ( SELECT AM.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID FROM ACT_MEETING am WHERE AM.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'FCT_PROJECT' AND DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId} ) and AMRL.MEETING_RISK_CATEGORY='PAYMENT'
